task_spec: PR: make refunds a first-class order status. Adds REFUNDED to status.py and sets order.state = REFUNDED in process_refund, then notifies the customer.

bugs.description: The PR adds REFUNDED as a new status and sets order.state = REFUNDED, but the MESSAGES table in notify.py (NOT in the diff) has no REFUNDED entry, so MESSAGES.get(order.state, DEFAULT) falls through to the default -- which is 'Your order was delivered.' A refunded customer is told their order was delivered. Catching it requires cross-referencing the new enum value against the dispatch table in another (unchanged) file and noticing the wrong default. The generic-looking default hides it.

provenance.note: CROSS-FILE DESYNC: the new enum case has no branch in the dispatch table in another file, silently taking a wrong default. The stale table is OUTSIDE the diff.
